cells.docstring: Loads an image from a file into a numpy.ndarray.

image_path.description: Filesystem path to the image file to decode.

flags.description: Flag that can take values of cv2.ImreadModes (e.g. cv2.IMREAD_COLOR=1, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE=0).

output_var.description: Loaded image array with shape (H, W, 3) or (H, W).

preconditions.description: Target image path must be a valid file path string.

cells.docstring: Saves an image tensor to a specified path in the filesystem.

output_path.description: Filesystem path where the serialized image file will be written.

image.description: Image matrix to write to persistent storage.

output_var.description: Boolean flag indicating whether image serialization succeeded.

preconditions.description: Image array must have at least 2 dimensions.

postconditions.description: Returns true when writing was successful.

cells.docstring: Renders an image tensor inside a graphical operating system window.

winname.description: Identifier title for the host OS window.

image.description: Image tensor to project into the window canvas.

cells.docstring: Waits for a pressed key event during HighGUI window rendering loop.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds. 0 means wait indefinitely until a keypress.

output_var.description: ASCII / Unicode keycode integer or -1 on timeout.

cells.docstring: Destroys all opened HighGUI windows and releases OS window handles.
Converts an image from BGR color space to single-channel Grayscale.
Replicates single-channel grayscale across 3 BGR channels.

output_var.description: 3-channel BGR matrix with identical channel planes.

cells.docstring: Swaps blue and red channel planes to convert standard OpenCV BGR to RGB.

postconditions.description: Output is in RGB color space.

cells.docstring: Transforms an image from BGR to Hue-Saturation-Value (HSV) color space.

output_var.description: HSV transformed tensor with Hue in range [0, 179].

cells.docstring: Converts BGR image to CIE L*a*b* perceptually uniform color space.

preconditions.description: Source image must possess 3 color channels.

postconditions.description: Output is in LAB color space.

cells.docstring: Resizes an image using specified interpolation method and spatial target dimensions.

interpolation.description: Interpolation algorithm flag (e.g. cv2.INTER_LINEAR=1, cv2.INTER_AREA=3, cv2.INTER_CUBIC=2).

preconditions.description: Input tensor must have rank 2 or greater.

cells.docstring: Applies an affine transformation matrix (2x3) to an image tensor.

border_mode.description: Pixel extrapolation method border type flag.

cells.docstring: Calculates an affine 2D rotation and isotropic scaling matrix around a specified center point.

center.description: Center point coordinates of rotation (x, y).

cells.docstring: Applies a perspective transformation matrix (3x3 homography) to an image tensor.

preconditions.description: Perspective matrix M must be shape (3, 3).

cells.docstring: Calculates a 3x3 perspective transformation matrix from 4 pairs of source and destination points.

src_pts.description: Coordinates of quadrangle vertices in source image (shape: 4x2, float32).

dst_pts.description: Coordinates of corresponding quadrangle vertices in destination image (shape: 4x2, float32).

cells.docstring: Flips a 2D array around vertical, horizontal, or both axes.

flip_code.description: Axis selector: 0 for vertical (X-axis), 1 for horizontal (Y-axis), -1 for both axes.

output_var.description: Flipped image array with same shape and type.

preconditions.description: Input matrix must have at least 2 dimensions.

cells.docstring: Convolves image with a 2D Gaussian kernel to suppress high frequency noise.

ksize.description: Gaussian kernel size (width, height). Both must be positive and odd integers.

sigma_x.description: Gaussian kernel standard deviation in horizontal X direction. 0 means computed from ksize.

sigma_y.description: Gaussian kernel standard deviation in vertical Y direction.

preconditions.description: Kernel width and height must be positive and odd.

cells.docstring: Smooths image using a non-linear median filter, removing salt-and-pepper noise.

ksize.description: Aperture linear size; must be odd and greater than 1.

cells.docstring: Applies a bilateral filter to smooth textures while preserving sharp photometric edges.

d.description: Diameter of each pixel neighborhood used during filtering.

sigma_color.description: Filter sigma in the color space.

sigma_space.description: Filter sigma in the coordinate space.

cells.docstring: Convolves an image tensor with an arbitrary 2D linear convolution kernel.

ddepth.description: Desired depth of destination image (-1 keeps same as src).

kernel.description: Convolution kernel, single-channel floating point matrix.

cells.docstring: Calculates first, second, third, or mixed image derivatives using an extended Sobel operator.

ddepth.description: Output image depth (e.g. cv2.CV_64F or cv2.CV_16S).

dx.description: Order of the derivative along X axis.

dy.description: Order of the derivative along Y axis.

ksize.description: Size of the extended Sobel kernel; must be 1, 3, 5, or 7.

preconditions.description: Derivative order in at least one direction must be positive.

postconditions.description: Result is a gradient map tensor.

cells.docstring: Calculates the Laplacian of an image tensor by summing second x and y derivatives.

ddepth.description: Desired depth of destination tensor (e.g. cv2.CV_64F).

ksize.description: Aperture size used to compute second-derivative filters; must be positive and odd.

preconditions.description: ksize must be an odd positive integer.

cells.docstring: Finds edges in an image using the Canny hysteresis thresholding algorithm.

src.description: Single-channel 8-bit input grayscale or pre-blurred image.

threshold1.description: First threshold for the hysteresis procedure (lower limit).

threshold2.description: Second threshold for the hysteresis procedure (upper limit).

aperture_size.description: Aperture size for the Sobel operator; must be 3, 5, or 7.

l2_gradient.description: Flag indicating whether to use more accurate L2 norm for gradient magnitude.

cells.docstring: Applies a fixed-level threshold to each array element, producing a binary mask.

maxval.description: Maximum value assigned to pixels exceeding the threshold.

cells.docstring: Computes optimal global binarization threshold automatically using Otsu's intra-class variance minimization.

maxval.description: Value to assign to binary high pixels.

ret.description: Optimal threshold value determined by Otsu algorithm.

preconditions.description: Source tensor must be 2D single channel.

cells.docstring: Applies adaptive thresholding using a Gaussian-weighted local neighborhood window.

maxval.description: Non-zero value assigned to satisfying pixels.

block_size.description: Size of pixel neighborhood used to calculate threshold; odd number > 1.

C.description: Constant subtracted from the mean or weighted sum.

preconditions.description: block_size must be an odd number greater than 1.

cells.docstring: Checks if array elements lie between boundary scalar values across channels, generating a binary mask.

src.description: First input array (e.g. in HSV or BGR color space).

lowerb.description: Inclusive lower boundary array or tuple of scalars.

upperb.description: Inclusive upper boundary array or tuple of scalars.

cells.docstring: Returns a structuring element kernel of the specified shape and size for morphological operations.

ksize.description: Size of the structuring element kernel (width, height).

cells.docstring: Erodes an image by using a specific structuring element kernel.

kernel.description: Structuring element kernel used for erosion.

iterations.description: Number of times erosion is applied.

cells.docstring: Dilates an image by expanding local maxima using a structuring element kernel.

kernel.description: Structuring element kernel used for dilation.

iterations.description: Number of times dilation is applied.

cells.docstring: Performs morphological opening (erosion followed by dilation) to eliminate background noise artifacts.

output_var.description: Opened image matrix with isolated foreground noise removed.

cells.docstring: Performs morphological closing (dilation followed by erosion) to fill interior foreground holes.

output_var.description: Closed image matrix with internal holes filled.

cells.docstring: Extracts topological contours from a binary or edge image matrix using border-following.

image.description: 8-bit single-channel binary or edge image matrix.

mode.description: Contour retrieval mode: cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL=0, cv2.RETR_LIST=1, cv2.RETR_CCOMP=2, cv2.RETR_TREE=3.

contours.description: Detected contours returned as a list of numpy point coordinate arrays.

hierarchy.description: Optional topology hierarchy matrix of shape (1, N, 4).

preconditions.description: Input must be 2D single channel image.

cells.docstring: Draws contour outlines or filled polygons onto a canvas image.

image.description: Destination canvas image onto which outlines are drawn.

contours.description: List of point sequence arrays representing contours.

contour_idx.description: Index of contour to draw (-1 draws all contours).

thickness.description: Thickness of line. If negative (e.g. cv2.FILLED=-1), contour interiors are filled.

output_var.description: Image matrix with rendered contour vector graphics.

cells.docstring: Computes the geometric enclosed area of a contour polygon using Green's theorem.

oriented.description: Oriented area flag; if true returns signed area indicating clockwise/counterclockwise orientation.

output_var.description: Computed contour enclosed area scalar in square pixels.

cells.docstring: Calculates perimeter length or curve arc length of a contour sequence.

closed.description: Flag indicating whether curve is a closed polygon loop.

output_var.description: Computed curve length scalar in pixels.

cells.docstring: Calculates the upright minimal bounding box for a 2D point set.

array.description: Input 2D point set or single-channel gray/binary image matrix.

cells.docstring: Finds a circumscribed circle of minimum area to enclose a 2D point set.

center.description: Circle center coordinates tuple (x, y) float.

cells.docstring: Approximates a polygonal curve with another curve with fewer vertices using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm.

epsilon.description: Parameter specifying the maximum Hausdorff distance approximation accuracy.

closed.description: If true, the approximated curve is closed.

output_var.description: Approximated curve point array with reduced vertices.

cells.docstring: Computes the convex hull of a 2D point set using Sklansky's algorithm.

clockwise.description: Orientation flag. True for clockwise, False for counter-clockwise.

return_points.description: Operation flag. True to return coordinates, False to return integer point indices.

cells.docstring: Calculates all polygon spatial moments up to the 3rd order for a vector shape or rasterized raster.

array.description: Raster image or 2D point set array.

binary_image.description: If true, non-zero pixels are treated as 1.

cells.docstring: Computes element-wise per-element saturated sum of two image arrays.

src2.description: Second operand image matrix with matching size and depth.

cells.docstring: Computes element-wise saturated difference between two arrays.
Computes the weighted sum of two arrays to create alpha blending overlays.

alpha.description: Weight of the first image array elements.

src2.description: Second operand image matrix of matching shape and type.

beta.description: Weight of the second image array elements.

output_var.description: Blended array calculated as: src1*alpha + src2*beta + gamma.

preconditions.description: Both matrices must share shape and depth.

cells.docstring: Computes element-wise bitwise conjunction (AND) of two image arrays with an optional mask.

mask.description: Optional 8-bit single channel operation mask specifying elements to modify.

cells.docstring: Computes element-wise bitwise disjunction (OR) of two arrays.
Inverts all bits of each array element (photometric or mask inversion).
Calculates the per-element absolute difference between two arrays for frame differencing or motion detection.
Divides a multi-channel array into separate single-channel arrays.
Composes a multi-channel array from several single-channel arrays.

mv.description: List or tuple of single-channel arrays of identical dimensions.

cells.docstring: Computes a histogram of intensity or color channel distributions over an image array.

channels.description: List of the dims channels used to compute the histogram.

hist_size.description: Array of histogram bin counts in each dimension.

ranges.description: Array of the dims boundaries of bin values in each dimension.

cells.docstring: Equalizes the histogram of a grayscale image to enhance global dynamic contrast.
Normalizes the norm or value range of an array tensor.

alpha.description: Lower range boundary in case of range normalization.

beta.description: Upper range boundary in case of range normalization.

cells.docstring: Creates an instance of CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization).

tile_grid_size.description: Size of grid for histogram equalization (columns, rows).

cells.docstring: Applies CLAHE to a single-channel grayscale image tensor.

preconditions.description: Source must be 2D single channel image.

cells.docstring: Draws a line segment connecting two points on an image canvas.

img.description: Canvas image matrix to draw upon.

pt1.description: First point coordinates (x1, y1) of the line segment.

pt2.description: Second point coordinates (x2, y2) of the line segment.

line_type.description: Type of line boundary: cv2.LINE_8=8, cv2.LINE_4=4, cv2.LINE_AA=16 (antialiased).

cells.docstring: Draws an upright outline or filled rectangle on an image matrix.

color.description: Rectangle stroke color tuple (B, G, R).

thickness.description: Line thickness. Negative value (e.g. cv2.FILLED=-1) fills rectangle.

output_var.description: Image matrix with rendered bounding rectangle.

cells.docstring: Draws a circle outline or filled disc specified by center and radius.

center.description: Center of the circle coordinates (x, y).

radius.description: Radius of the circle in pixels.

thickness.description: Thickness of outline; negative fills circle.

cells.docstring: Renders a text string on an image canvas using built-in Hershey fonts.

org.description: Bottom-left corner coordinates of text string origin (x, y).

font_scale.description: Font scale factor that is multiplied by font-specific base size.

output_var.description: Canvas image matrix with labeled text string.

cells.docstring: Draws several polygonal curves onto an image canvas.

pts.description: List of polygonal curve vertex point coordinate arrays (int32).

is_closed.description: Flag indicating whether drawn polylines are closed polygons.

cells.docstring: Fills the area bounded by one or more polygonal contours with solid color.

img.description: Canvas image matrix or binary mask.

pts.description: Array of polygons where each polygon is an array of 2D points (int32).

output_var.description: Image matrix with filled polygonal interiors.

cells.docstring: Finds line segments in a binary edge image using the Probabilistic Hough Transform.

image.description: 8-bit single-channel binary edge image (e.g. Canny output).

rho.description: Distance resolution of the accumulator in pixels.

theta.description: Angle resolution of the accumulator in radians (e.g. np.pi/180).

threshold.description: Accumulator threshold parameter; only lines with sufficient votes are returned.

min_line_length.description: Minimum line length in pixels. Shorter segments are rejected.

max_line_gap.description: Maximum allowed gap between points on the same line to link them.

output_var.description: Array of detected line endpoints of shape (N, 1, 4) with entries [x1, y1, x2, y2].

preconditions.description: Input must be single-channel 2D binary edge tensor.

cells.docstring: Finds circles in a grayscale image using the 2-1 Hough Gradient Transform.

dp.description: Inverse ratio of accumulator resolution to image resolution.

min_dist.description: Minimum spatial distance between detected circle centers.

param1.description: Higher threshold passed to internal Canny edge detector.

param2.description: Accumulator threshold for circle centers at detection stage.

max_radius.description: Maximum circle radius in pixels (0 means unbounded).

output_var.description: Output vector of found circles (N, 1, 3) containing [center_x, center_y, radius].

cells.docstring: Calculates Harris corner detector response matrix from directional image derivatives.

src.description: Input single-channel 8-bit or floating-point grayscale array.

block_size.description: Neighborhood size for structure tensor integration.

ksize.description: Aperture parameter for the Sobel operator; odd number.

k.description: Harris detector free empirical sensitivity parameter.

cells.docstring: Determines strong corners on an image using the Shi-Tomasi corner detection algorithm.

max_corners.description: Maximum number of corners to return. Non-positive returns all detected corners.

quality_level.description: Minimal accepted quality level ratio multiplied by best corner response.

min_distance.description: Minimum possible Euclidean distance between returned corners.

block_size.description: Size of an average block for computing a derivative covariation matrix.

output_var.description: Detected corner coordinates array of shape (N, 1, 2) with float32 values.

cells.docstring: Instantiates a Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) feature detector and descriptor extractor.

n_features.description: The number of best features to retain (0 means unlimited).

contrast_threshold.description: The contrast threshold used to filter out weak features in semi-uniform regions.

edge_threshold.description: The threshold used to filter out edge-like features.

sigma.description: The sigma of the base Gaussian applied to input image at octave #0.

cells.docstring: Detects scale-space extrema keypoints and calculates 128-dimensional local SIFT gradient histograms.
Instantiates an Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB) binary feature detector and descriptor extractor.

n_features.description: The maximum number of features to retain.

n_levels.description: The number of pyramid scale levels.

cells.docstring: Detects keypoints and extracts 32-byte (256-bit) binary BRIEF descriptors using ORB.

descriptors.description: 256-bit binary descriptors array of shape (N, 32) uint8.

preconditions.description: Input image must be single channel.

cells.docstring: Constructs a Brute-Force feature matcher using L2 or Hamming distance metric.

norm_type.description: Distance metric flag: cv2.NORM_L2=4 (for SIFT), cv2.NORM_HAMMING=6 (for ORB).

cross_check.description: If true, pairs (i, j) are returned only when each is mutual nearest neighbor.

cells.docstring: Finds the best 1-to-1 match for each descriptor from query set in training set.

train_descriptors.description: Training descriptor matrix of matching feature width and type.

cells.docstring: Renders detected keypoints as circular vectors onto an image tensor.

out_image.description: Destination canvas image or None to allocate newly.

output_var.description: Image matrix decorated with keypoint circular overlays.

cells.docstring: Renders lines connecting corresponding matched keypoint pairs across two images.

matches1to2.description: List of cv2.DMatch correspondences between keypoints1 and keypoints2.

output_var.description: Side-by-side composite canvas with matching correspondence line vectors.

cells.docstring: Pads an image matrix with artificial surrounding borders using specified extrapolation modes.

value.description: Padding fill color if border_type is cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT.

output_var.description: Spatially expanded image matrix with padded boundaries.

cells.docstring: Scales, computes absolute values, and converts results to unsigned 8-bit integers.

src.description: Input floating-point or integer array (e.g. Sobel derivative matrix).

output_var.description: 8-bit unsigned integer array of absolute scaled amplitudes.

postconditions.description: Resulting tensor is guaranteed uint8 depth.

cells.docstring: Executes marker-based image segmentation using the topological watershed algorithm.

markers.description: 32-bit signed integer single-channel marker image array with rough component labels.
Updated marker matrix where boundaries are designated with -1.

preconditions.description: Marker array must be 32-bit signed integer.

cells.docstring: Restores damaged or occluded parts of an image using neighboring texture synthesis.

inpaint_mask.description: 8-bit 1-channel inpainting mask where non-zero pixels specify areas to repair.

inpaint_radius.description: Radius of circular neighborhood considered around each repaired point.

flags.description: Inpainting algorithm flag: cv2.INPAINT_TELEA=1 or cv2.INPAINT_NS=0 (Navier-Stokes).

cells.docstring: Attenuates colored noise artifacts using the Non-Local Means algorithm across color planes.

h.description: Parameter regulating filter strength for luminance component.

h_color.description: Parameter regulating filter strength for color components.

template_window_size.description: Size in pixels of template patch used to compute weights (odd integer).

search_window_size.description: Size in pixels of window used to search for similar patches (odd integer).

cells.docstring: Opens a video file or hardware video capturing device camera stream.

source.description: Camera hardware device index integer (e.g. 0) or filesystem path string to video container.

cells.docstring: Grabs, decodes, and returns the next successive video frame from the capture device.

ret.description: Success boolean flag. False if no frames were grabbed.

frame.description: Decoded video frame array (H, W, 3) BGR uint8.

postconditions.description: Decoded frame is in standard BGR state.

cells.docstring: Closes video capturing device handle and releases operating system resources.
Initializes a VideoWriter object to encode and serialize successive video frames to disk.

is_color.description: If true encoder expects color frames.

cells.docstring: Encodes and appends a single frame matrix to the open video destination file.

image.description: Image matrix matching specified dimensions and color setting.

cells.docstring: Finalizes container headers and closes the serialized video stream sink.

writer.description: VideoWriter object to flush and close.

cells.docstring: Encodes an image tensor into a memory buffer containing compressed format data (e.g. JPEG, PNG).

buf.description: Single-dimension contiguous 1D array of encoded binary bytes.

cells.docstring: Reads and decodes an image from an in-memory byte buffer into a numpy matrix.

buf.description: Contiguous 1D buffer containing raw encoded image bytes.

postconditions.description: Decoded image is in standard BGR state.
